name: projects-pack-delegation
description: Install the bounded local runtime used by the private Projects coordination and PR service.

interface.shortDescription: Use the private Projects service with bounded local PR effects.
interface.longDescription: The authenticated Projects service owns coordination, lifecycle, review, acceptance, and readiness decisions. This public component installs only a bounded local Git and GitHub runner with a frozen wire contract, durable recovery journal, and closed mechanical actions. It cannot mark ready, merge, deploy, or run candidate verification.
defaultPrompt: Use the authenticated Projects service for this tracked work.
